Revisa for Centres — revision sessions and attendance on one page

Revisa for Centres helps small tutoring centres plan exam-season revision sessions by subject, teacher and group, record attendance, and export the week's plan. It runs in the browser with no installation. It is an early product built by a student founder; the first term is a free pilot and feedback shapes what comes next.

  • Schedule sessions by subject, teacher, group and time
  • Record attendance after each session
  • Search and filter the week's plan
  • Export the plan as CSV

Centre: 1,500 EGP (per term 4 months)

Prices are proposals under test. Draft policies require legal review.
